attempts.bug_summary: The generated implementation for greater-than-or-equal predicates uses strict greater-than comparison instead. As a result, records whose values exactly equal the predicate value are incorrectly rejected.

The generated source is flushed but the FileWriter is not closed after generation. This leaves the writer open and changes repeat-invocation and resource-release behavior even though the first generated file contents remain correct.

The generated handler for LogicalNotUserDefined predicates is built without enabling the negated-predicate behavior. As a result, generated filters evaluate user-defined predicates as though they were not negated.
